status: source stable for parent Film integration; not a full-film approval

gpu.renderer: ANGLE (NVIDIA, NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5060 Laptop GPU (0x00002D59) Direct3D11 vs_5_0 ps_5_0, D3D11)

typecheck: npm run check / tsc --noEmit passed after last source change
inspection_scope: Contact sheets plus native keyframes. Dense front/side strips inspect 1.4–4.4 and 8.2–11.2 seconds every 0.2 seconds. Continuous 10 fps MP4s supplied; this report does not claim every video frame was manually watched.
metric_method: Closest points on posed connected grip-hand triangles; 4 zero-area marching-cubes triangles skipped. Food clearance subtracts conservative 9 mm food radius; tine clearance subtracts 2 mm; table clearance tests fork/food mesh vertices against y=0.707 m. Grip clearance is unsigned surface distance and is a contact check, not exhaustive volumetric collision proof.
changes: Fixed-size food bound to a fixed-direction fork; one restrained presentation lift and return, no false swallowing.
Connected palm/phalange grip at atlas wrist scale; dorsal-up with curved fingers and thumb countergrip.
Pose-first fixed-length arm transforms with pronation on local forearm axis; eliminates ribbon-like intermediate forearms.
Independent connected shorts with two separated legs; neutral genital silhouette; shared leg IK and measurement pose.
Fixed-length leg IK and modest forward trunk hinge during sit/stand.
Parked drinks hidden; opening sweet drink and late water state are explicit.

integration.anatomyBlend: 0→1 resets seated and all actions/adiposity; reveal static atlas organs only once poseResidual < 0.001. World must coordinate final measurement writer.
integration.sitStand: Do not pass seatedWeight=0 for ordinary sitStand; leave undefined so internal action is allowed to sit.
integration.drink: Parent removed exchange demonstration from h012; only initial sweet and final water state are used. Moving exchange lane has not been approved for arbitrary side-camera final shots.
integration.props: Parent World owns table/cuff exit and writer handoff; complete Film preview02 must verify h078/h079 and h066–h068, h087.

limitations: A teaching rig, not motion capture, cloth simulation or patient-specific anatomy.
Atlas skin retains original faceting and a small grip-hand/wrist junction can be seen in extreme closeup.
Cloth checked visually at sampled action poses; no exhaustive fabric/skin collision solver was run.
No full-film, final overlay, audio or delivery render was changed or approved by this subtask.
